question:
Which two signs and two numbers should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

14 × 6 ÷ 12 + 15 - 9 = 203
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] Given statement : **14 × 6 ÷ 12 + 15 - 9 = 203** **According to the question, after interchanging the given two signs and two numbers :** So, __ • Option - (1) : 15, 6, +, ÷ 14 × 15 + **12 ÷ 6**__ - 9 = 203 __**14 × 15**__ + 2 - 9 = 203 __**210 + 2**__ - 9 = 203
